text:
Jordan (AE): Kicking off alignment with the customer (FinApps) — they want a 4-week POC covering: 1) inbox summarization, 2) document QA (extractive), 3) relevance reranking for search. Need acceptance criteria + timeline. Ping @Anya for evals and Sam for perf/cost. TL;DR: they require SLA-like targets for latency and a rough per-call cost estimate for budgeting.
Anya (SE): Sounds good. For each use case we should provide a prompt set (50-100 examples) + automated evals + 200 human review samples. Proposed eval metrics: exact_match for QA, NDCG@10 for rerank, and ROUGE-L + human pass-rate >= 85% for summarization.
Sam (ML Eng): Perf baseline: hosted redwood-1-small p95 token-gen ~120ms for typical prompts (256 tokens). For combined workload expect p95 end-to-end latencies: summarization 300-500ms, QA 200-350ms, rerank depends on candidates (N=10 -> ~450ms). Can get p95 <250ms if customer uses Dedicated with batching + KV cache and trims context to 128 tokens.
Lee (CSE): Budget/Q ask from buyer: what does POC cost look like? They want estimate for 4 weeks, ~10k inference requests. Rough hosted estimate: ~ $0.06 / 1k tokens -> need more precise after prompt length estimates. We should offer hosted vs Dedicated numbers and a capped budget option for execs.
Anya (SE): For acceptance thresholds I'd suggest: summarization human-pass >=85% AND ROUGE-L >=0.45; QA exact_match >=78%; rerank NDCG@10 >=0.60. Latency p95 <=300ms on hosted or <=200ms on Dedicated. Cost per 1k tokens <= $0.08 hosted, or committed Dedicated equivalent <= $0.04.
Jordan (AE): Customer also asked about ramp timeline: start next Mon, 2-week integration + 2-week eval, with demo at week 3. Is that realistic?
Sam (ML Eng): Yes if we get seed data + sample prompts early. Integration checklist: API keys, sample dataset, CORS, SSO for Private if needed, and the eval harness. I'll drop a test script here.
Sam (ML Eng): ```bash
# run local eval harness
python -m redwood_eval.runner --model redwood-1-small --prompt-set poc_finapps_v1 --n=200 --metrics rouge,exact_match,ndcg
```
Anya (SE): We'll prepare prompt templates and the three eval sets; suggest we freeze prompt set v1 after integration week so metrics are stable during the eval window.
Lee (CSE): Security asks: they want SOC2 report, KMS options, and clarity on data retention and IP. Ava (sec-bot) can you confirm what we can share for a POC?
Ava (sec-bot): SOC2 report OK to share under NDA; support KMS via AWS KMS for Private deployments; we can provide short answers to their security questionnaire (I DM'd the checklist to Jordan).
Jordan (AE): Great. Action items: (1) Anya to post prompt/eval plan by Tue EOD. (2) Sam to post perf/cost quick model options + test script. (3) Lee to share POC budget slide + security checklist. I'll send the timeline to the customer today. :thumbsup: 
Lee (CSE): I'll draft the budget slide, target two options: hosted pay-as-you-go and dedicated commit with estimated commit level.
Jordan (AE): Thanks team — quick sync Thurs 9am to finalize. If anyone sees blockers reply here.
Anya (SE): Noted. I'll include the acceptance gate checklist and precise evaluation thresholds in the doc.
Sam (ML Eng): On it, will also add quantization and batching tradeoffs for cost/latency.
Lee (CSE): I'll flag any legal items before Thurs.
Jordan (AE): Closing loop — customer generally happy with targets in principle; they want final slides by Thurs noon.
